title: Caption boxed
description: Use for clean, professional captions on a rounded dark panel with the spoken word on an accent chip (explainers, interviews). The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
props: {captions: Caption[]; maxWordsPerPage?: number /*5*/; boxColor?: string; color?: string; chipColor?: string /*'#3b82f6'*/; fontSize?: number; fontFamily?: string /*'Inter, sans-serif'*/}
